title: [BUG] extended thinking doen't work (think, think hard, think harder)
body:

- [x] I am using the latest version of Claude Code

### What's Wrong?

I've used Claude Code in wsl2. An hour ago, `think`, `think hard` worked very well. But after update to 4.5 sonnet, It doesn't work. I've typed think , think hard, think harder many times but CC doesn't think at all. How do I activate thinking mode?

### What Should Happen?

It should work extended thinking.

top_comments.author: Gabbo7474
top_comments.body:
Same, in my understanding using tab to trigger thinking mode should act like this:
Thinking on: Uses thinking for all requests.
Thinking off: Thinking is off by default but when using a keyword like "think", "think hard", etc. Thinking should be enabled for the current request and put back to off after the answer.
Right now what I'm seeing is:
Thinking on: Always thinks, as expected
Thinking off: Never thinks even when using a keyword, does not work as expected
